verdict.rationale: Internal comment threads and @mentions beside an email are a fair axis for an email service, but nothing in the evidence documents Fastmail offering message comments, @mentions or side-threads. The evidence covers JMAP, filters, templates, aliases, snooze and similar features, none of which deliver this story.

support.subject: As a team-lead, we can discuss an email in an internal side-thread — comments and @mentions beside the message — instead of forwarding copies around
